name: im.inkloom/mcp
title: Inkloom
description: Remote MCP for Inkloom AI image and video generation with OAuth.

tools.name: inkloom_list_models
tools.description: List active Inkloom generation models with their modes, adjustable output options, SKU dimensions, and credit pricing. Call this before quoting or creating a generation.

tools.name: inkloom_quote_generation
tools.description: Price a generation request without creating it or spending credits. Returns the exact credit price and the user's balance.

tools.name: inkloom_create_generation
tools.description: Start an image or video generation that spends the user's credits. Quote first and pass the accepted price as maxCredits. Returns immediately with a generation ID; poll inkloom_get_generation until it completes or fails.

tools.name: inkloom_list_generations
tools.description: List generation tasks owned by the authenticated Inkloom user.

tools.name: inkloom_get_generation
tools.description: Get one generation task owned by the authenticated Inkloom user, including output URLs once completed.
